name: intro
description: Introduce two or more people from the owner's network: resolve and confirm both identities, DM each side for consent before any group exists, then create the group and introduce both sides inside it. Requires the owner's approval first. Triggers: "/intro", "introduce X and Y", "connect X with Y".
